# Overview

This document evaluates CAMERA's pcgroups against the compound-centric,
tier-stratified reference set from MS1Match on SuperPool: a pooled sample
of MSMLS standards, matched against the CBIO in-house library restricted to
the pool's targets.

It has two parts:

- **Grouping (Steps 1–3).** All reference-relative counts (Ref-confirmed,
  Ref-conflicting, ...) come from `evaluate_grouping()`. This is the same
  function, with the same definitions, used for RAMClustR
  (`SuperPool_RAMClustR_evaluation.Rmd`) and in vignette 3.
- **CAMERA-specific analysis (Steps 4–6).** This covers what only CAMERA
  has: pcgroup purity, adduct annotation coverage and accuracy, the
  annotation confusion analysis and the compound case studies.

For each compound, the Tier 1a `[M+H]+` feature is the **anchor**; the pcgroup
CAMERA assigns to it is the compound's expected group. Every reference compound
has an anchor by construction.

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| *Reference features (first status that applies):* | |
| Ref-unassigned (no-anchor) | CAMERA did not assign a pcgroup to the compound's anchor; none of its features can be evaluated (0 for CAMERA) |
| Ref-unassigned | The anchor is in a pcgroup, this feature is not (0 for CAMERA) |
| Ref-confirmed | Same pcgroup as its compound's anchor |
| Ref-conflicting | Different pcgroup than its compound's anchor |
| *Features outside the reference set:* | |
| Ref-unmatched, co-grouped | In a pcgroup with a compound anchor (possible over-grouping) |
| Ref-unmatched, unrelated | In a pcgroup without an anchor, or in no pcgroup |

The reference set uses these tiers:

| Tier | Annotation type | Phase |
|---|---|---|
| Tier 1a | ESI ion match via direct library matching | Phase 1 |
| Tier 1b | Isotope peaks | Phase 1 |
| Tier 1c | In-source MS2 fragments | Phase 1 |
| Tier 1d | Neutral loss pairs | Phase 1 |
| Tier 2 | Unexplained co-eluting features | Phase 1 |
| Tier 1a_exp – 1d_exp | The same evidence types, found in the Phase 2 expansion | Phase 2 |

# Setup

## Load packages

```{r packages}
library(MS1Match)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

dataset <- "SuperPool"
```

## Running CAMERA (not run)

This chunk shows how the cached CAMERA peak list was produced from the xcms
object. The `feature_name` ids it creates must match the MS1Match feature
table; Step 2 verifies this.

```{r camera-run, eval = FALSE}
library(CAMERA)

xcms_out <- readRDS(system.file("extdata", "RDS_files", "SuperPool",
                                "SuperPool_MS1MS2_result.rds",
                                package = "MS1Match"))
xset     <- as(xcms_out$result$x_exp, "xcmsSet")

# MS1-only samples
ms1_idx <- which(!grepl("MSMS", rownames(phenoData(xset))))
xsa     <- xsAnnotate(xset, sample = ms1_idx)

anF  <- groupFWHM(xsa, perfwhm = 0.6)
anI  <- findIsotopes(anF, mzabs = 0.01)
anIC <- groupCorr(anI, cor_eic_th = 0.75)
anFA <- findAdducts(anIC, polarity = "positive")

peaklist <- getPeaklist(anFA) %>%
  mutate(feature_name = sprintf("FT%04d", row_number())) %>%
  select(feature_name, everything()) %>%
  filter(rt >= 60 & rt <= 1200)

# write.csv(peaklist, "CAMERA_annotated_SuperPool_FT.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

## Load data

`anno_result` must have been built on the feature table passed as
`feature_table` below. In vignette 2b, this is the xcms feature table
filtered to the 60–1200 s RT window.

```{r load-data}
data_dir <- system.file("extdata", "RDS_files", "SuperPool", package = "MS1Match")

out <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "SuperPool_MS1MS2_result.rds"))

# The feature table MS1Match was run on (vignette 2b)
ft_sub <- out$ft %>% filter(rtmed >= 60 & rtmed <= 1200)

anno_result <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "anno_result_SuperPool.rds"))

CAMERA_ft_sub <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "CAMERA_annotated_SuperPool_FT.csv")) %>%
  filter(rt >= 60 & rt <= 1200)
```

```{r data-summary}
summ <- anno_result$export_feature_compound_summary

data.frame(
  item  = c("Feature table rows", "Reference rows (feature x compound)",
            "Reference features", "Compound instances",
            "CAMERA features", "CAMERA pcgroups"),
  n     = c(nrow(ft_sub), nrow(summ),
            n_distinct(summ$feature_name), n_distinct(summ$Compound_name),
            nrow(CAMERA_ft_sub), n_distinct(CAMERA_ft_sub$pcgroup))
) %>%
  kable(caption = paste(dataset, "inputs")) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)
```

---

# Part 1 — Grouping evaluation

## Step 1 — Grouping table

```{r grouping-table}
grouping_cam <- camera_to_grouping(CAMERA_ft_sub)
head(grouping_cam)
```

## Step 2 — Same feature table?

```{r feature-match}
check_feature_match(anno_result, grouping_cam, ft_sub)
```

This must say YES. If it says NO, the `feature_name` ids of the CAMERA peak
list do not refer to the same features as the MS1Match table; every number
below would then be wrong.

## Step 3 — Evaluate

```{r evaluate}
eval_cam <- evaluate_grouping(
  anno_result, grouping_cam,
  tool_name     = "CAMERA",
  feature_table = ft_sub,
  rt_window     = c(60, 1200)     # same window as for RAMClustR
)
eval_cam

bm <- eval_cam$benchmark
stopifnot(with(bm, n_confirmed + n_conflicting + n_unassigned +
                   n_no_anchor + n_not_evaluable == n_ref))
```

---

# Part 2 — CAMERA-specific analysis

These steps use the CAMERA functions of MS1Match. They join on
`feature_name`; Step 2 has already checked that the ids match.

## Step 4 — Evaluation table, anchors and pcgroup purity

```{r build-eval-full}
eval_full <- build_eval_full(
  feature_compound_summary = anno_result$export_feature_compound_summary,
  CAMERA_ft                = CAMERA_ft_sub
)

eval_full %>%
  count(reference_tier, annotation_phase) %>%
  arrange(reference_tier) %>%
  kable(caption = "Reference rows per tier") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r build-anchors}
# export_reduced_anno_table keeps all tier rows per feature x compound, so
# the Tier1a [M+H]+ row is found even when the best tier of that feature is
# a different one.
anchors <- build_anchors(
  eval_full = eval_full,
  full_anno = anno_result$export_reduced_anno_table
)
```

```{r build-purity}
purity <- build_pcgroup_purity(
  CAMERA_ft = CAMERA_ft_sub,
  eval_full = eval_full,
  anchors   = anchors
)

ap <- purity$anchor_pcgroups

data.frame(
  item  = c("Pure anchor pcgroups (1 compound)", "Over-grouped anchor pcgroups (2+)",
            "No adduct evidence (NA)", "Mean compounds per anchor pcgroup",
            "Median compounds per anchor pcgroup", "Max compounds in one pcgroup",
            "Mean features outside reference per anchor pcgroup"),
  value = c(sum(ap$pcgroup_n_compounds == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
            sum(ap$pcgroup_n_compounds > 1,  na.rm = TRUE),
            sum(is.na(ap$pcgroup_n_compounds)),
            round(mean(ap$pcgroup_n_compounds,   na.rm = TRUE), 1),
            median(ap$pcgroup_n_compounds,       na.rm = TRUE),
            max(ap$pcgroup_n_compounds,          na.rm = TRUE),
            round(mean(ap$pcgroup_outside_ref,   na.rm = TRUE), 1))
) %>%
  kable(caption = "Over-grouping of anchor pcgroups") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r compound-pcgroup-table}
compound_pcgroup_table <- anchors %>%
  left_join(ap %>% select(pcgroup, pcgroup_n_features, pcgroup_n_compounds,
                          pcgroup_outside_ref),
            by = c("anchor_pcgroup" = "pcgroup")) %>%
  left_join(eval_full %>% count(Compound_name, name = "reference_features"),
            by = "Compound_name") %>%
  mutate(outside_ref_pct = round(100 * pcgroup_outside_ref / pcgroup_n_features, 1)) %>%
  select(Compound_name, reference_features, pcgroup_n_compounds,
         pcgroup_outside_ref, pcgroup_n_features, outside_ref_pct) %>%
  arrange(desc(reference_features))

compound_pcgroup_table
```

```{r build-plot2-data}
plot2_data <- build_plot2_data(CAMERA_ft = CAMERA_ft_sub, mass_digits = 4L)

plot2_data %>%
  count(grouping_class) %>%
  kable(caption = "All pcgroups with adduct annotation: distinct neutral masses per pcgroup") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r build-compound-eval}
# needed by build_benchmark_table() and inspect_compound()
compound_eval_wide <- build_compound_eval(eval_full, anchors, purity)
```

## Step 5 — Tier 1a adduct annotation

CAMERA also labels adducts. Two metrics are reported for Tier 1a / 1a_exp
features:

- **Coverage:** the share of features CAMERA gave any adduct label.
- **Accuracy:** among those, the share whose CAMERA adduct m/z matches the
  MS1Match m/z within 10 ppm.

```{r build-anno-accuracy}
anno_accuracy <- build_anno_accuracy(eval_full, anchors, ppm_tol = 10)
```

### Coverage and accuracy by tier

```{r anno-accuracy-summary}
anno_accuracy$summary %>%
  kable(
    caption   = "Tier 1a adduct annotation: coverage and accuracy",
    col.names = c("Tier", "Total features", "Unannotated (CAMERA)",
                  "Annotated (CAMERA)", "Correct", "Wrong",
                  "Coverage (%)", "Accuracy (%)"),
    digits    = 1
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed")) %>%
  row_spec(nrow(anno_accuracy$summary), bold = TRUE) %>%
  footnote(general = c(
    "Coverage = features with any CAMERA adduct label / all Tier 1a features.",
    "Accuracy = CAMERA adduct m/z within 10 ppm of the MS1Match m/z / labelled features.",
    "If CAMERA gave a feature several labels, a match to any one counts as correct.",
    "Tier 1a uses grp_anno_match; Tier 1a_exp uses exp_anno_match."
  ))
```

### Per compound

```{r anno-accuracy-per-compound}
anno_accuracy$per_compound %>%
  arrange(desc(n_wrong)) %>%
  head(20) %>%
  kable(
    caption   = "Top 20 compounds by number of wrong CAMERA labels (Tier 1a / 1a_exp)",
    col.names = c("Lib_group", "Compound", "Tier", "Total",
                  "Unannotated", "Annotated", "Correct", "Wrong",
                  "Coverage (%)", "Accuracy (%)"),
    digits    = 1
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed", "hover"))
```

### Confusion: which labels are wrong

```{r confusion-matrix}
extract_mz <- function(x) {
  if (is.na(x) || nchar(trimws(x)) == 0L) return(NA_real_)
  m <- regmatches(x, regexpr("[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+$", x))
  if (length(m) == 0L || m == "") NA_real_ else as.numeric(m)
}

ion_pattern <- "^\\[\\d*M[^]]+\\][0-9]*[+-]"

confusion_detail <- eval_full %>%
  filter(reference_tier %in% c("Tier1a_AnnoMatch", "Tier1a_exp_AnnoMatch")) %>%
  mutate(
    MS1Match_adduct       = if_else(reference_tier == "Tier1a_exp_AnnoMatch",
                                    exp_anno_match, grp_anno_match),
    MS1Match_annotation   = str_extract(MS1Match_adduct, ion_pattern),
    CAMERA_annotation     = str_extract(CAMERA_adduct,   ion_pattern),
    has_CAMERA_annotation = !is.na(CAMERA_adduct) & nchar(trimws(CAMERA_adduct)) > 0,
    MS1Match_mz           = vapply(MS1Match_adduct, extract_mz, numeric(1L)),
    annotation_ok = mapply(function(cam_str, ref_mz) {
      if (is.na(ref_mz) || is.na(cam_str) || nchar(trimws(cam_str)) == 0L)
        return(FALSE)
      parts   <- trimws(unlist(strsplit(cam_str, "(?<=\\S)\\s+(?=\\[)", perl = TRUE)))
      cam_mzs <- vapply(parts, extract_mz, numeric(1L))
      cam_mzs <- cam_mzs[!is.na(cam_mzs)]
      length(cam_mzs) > 0L && any(abs(cam_mzs - ref_mz) / ref_mz * 1e6 <= 10)
    }, CAMERA_adduct, MS1Match_mz)
  ) %>%
  filter(has_CAMERA_annotation, !annotation_ok) %>%
  mutate(
    CAMERA_mz = vapply(CAMERA_adduct, extract_mz, numeric(1L)),
    ppm_err   = round(abs(CAMERA_mz - MS1Match_mz) / MS1Match_mz * 1e6, 1)
  ) %>%
  select(Compound_name, feature_name, reference_tier,
         MS1Match_annotation, CAMERA_annotation,
         MS1Match_adduct, CAMERA_adduct, ppm_err) %>%
  arrange(reference_tier, MS1Match_annotation, CAMERA_annotation)

confusion_detail %>%
  count(MS1Match_annotation, CAMERA_annotation, sort = TRUE) %>%
  kable(caption   = "Wrong Tier 1a labels: MS1Match ion vs CAMERA ion",
        col.names = c("MS1Match", "CAMERA", "n")) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed", "hover"))

confusion_detail %>%
  count(Compound_name, sort = TRUE) %>%
  head(15) %>%
  kable(caption   = "Compounds with most wrong Tier 1a labels",
        col.names = c("Compound", "n wrong")) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"))
```

### Root cause of wrong labels

```{r failure-cause}
failure_cause <- confusion_detail %>%
  left_join(eval_full %>%
              select(feature_name, Compound_name, reference_tier, pcgroup) %>%
              distinct(),
            by = c("feature_name", "Compound_name", "reference_tier")) %>%
  left_join(purity$all_pcgroups %>% select(pcgroup, pcgroup_n_compounds),
            by = "pcgroup") %>%
  mutate(failure_cause = case_when(
    pcgroup_n_compounds > 1  & MS1Match_annotation != CAMERA_annotation ~
      "Over-grouped: M and ion type both wrong",
    pcgroup_n_compounds > 1  & MS1Match_annotation == CAMERA_annotation ~
      "Over-grouped: M wrong, ion type coincidentally correct",
    pcgroup_n_compounds == 1 & MS1Match_annotation != CAMERA_annotation ~
      "Ion type misassigned (pure pcgroup)",
    TRUE ~
      "Neutral mass deviation >10 ppm (pure pcgroup, correct ion type)"
  ))

failure_cause %>%
  count(failure_cause, sort = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1)) %>%
  kable(caption   = "Root cause of wrong Tier 1a / 1a_exp labels",
        col.names = c("Cause", "n", "%")) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed")) %>%
  footnote(general = c(
    "Counts are feature x compound rows. Causes are diagnosed at the neutral-mass level.",
    "Over-grouped: the pcgroup holds more than one compound, which corrupts CAMERA's inferred M.",
    "Ion type misassigned: the pcgroup is pure and M is correct, but the ion type is wrong.",
    "Neutral mass deviation: pure pcgroup, correct ion type, M off by >10 ppm; typically multimers ([2M+...]), where the error scales with the multiplier."
  ))
```

## Step 6 — Benchmark table

The Ref-* counts come from `evaluate_grouping()` (Step 3). The adduct
annotation columns come from Step 5.

```{r benchmark-table}
# adduct annotation columns per tier (Step 5)
anno_cols <- build_benchmark_table(compound_eval_wide, anno_accuracy, purity) %>%
  mutate(Tier = if_else(Tier == "TOTAL", "Total", Tier)) %>%
  select(Tier, contains("coverage"), contains("accuracy"),
         any_of("CAMERA_has_concept"))

benchmark <- eval_cam$benchmark %>%
  select(Tier, n_ref, n_confirmed, pct_confirmed,
         n_conflicting, pct_conflicting, n_not_evaluable) %>%
  left_join(anno_cols, by = "Tier")

# display version: n and % in one cell, coverage / accuracy as % or "-"
.n_pct <- function(n, pct) sprintf("%d (%.1f %%)", as.integer(n), pct)
.pct   <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "-", sprintf("%.1f", x))

benchmark_display <- benchmark %>%
  transmute(
    Tier,
    `Ref set`         = n_ref,
    `Ref-confirmed`   = .n_pct(n_confirmed,   pct_confirmed),
    `Ref-conflicting` = .n_pct(n_conflicting, pct_conflicting),
    across(c(contains("coverage"), contains("accuracy")), .pct)
  )

k <- benchmark_display %>%
  kable(caption = paste0("CAMERA tier-stratified benchmark against the ",
                         "compound-centric reference set (", dataset, ")."),
        align = c("l", rep("r", ncol(benchmark_display) - 1))) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE, position = "left", font_size = 13) %>%
  row_spec(nrow(benchmark_display), bold = TRUE)

exp_rows <- which(grepl("_exp$", benchmark_display$Tier))
if (length(exp_rows) > 0L) k <- row_spec(k, exp_rows, italic = TRUE)

k %>%
  footnote(general = c(
    "Ref set = reference feature x compound rows in that tier (best tier per feature x compound).",
    "Ref-confirmed = in the anchor's pcgroup; Ref-conflicting = in another pcgroup; % of Ref set.",
    "Ref-unassigned and Ref-unassigned (no-anchor) not shown: CAMERA gives every feature a pcgroup, so both are 0.",
    "Coverage / accuracy (%): Tier 1a and Tier 1a_exp only (Step 5); - = not applicable.",
    "Total row: feature-weighted sums across tiers. Italic rows: Phase 2 expansion tiers."
  )) %>%
  scroll_box(width = "100%")
```

```{r benchmark-crosscheck, include = FALSE}
# Silent guard: the CAMERA-specific functions must give the same counts as
# evaluate_grouping(). Knitting stops here if they ever differ.
benchmark_camera <- build_benchmark_table(compound_eval_wide, anno_accuracy, purity) %>%
  mutate(Tier = if_else(Tier == "TOTAL", "Total", Tier)) %>%
  select(Tier, n_ref = n_MS1Match, n_confirmed = n_CAMERA_grouped,
         n_conflicting = n_CAMERA_split)

crosscheck <- full_join(
  eval_cam$benchmark %>% select(Tier, n_ref, n_confirmed, n_conflicting),
  benchmark_camera, by = "Tier", suffix = c("", "_cam"))

same <- with(crosscheck, n_ref == n_ref_cam & n_confirmed == n_confirmed_cam &
                         n_conflicting == n_conflicting_cam)
if (!isTRUE(all(same)))   # NA (tier missing on one side) also counts as different
  stop("CAMERA-specific counts differ from evaluate_grouping():\n",
       paste(capture.output(print(crosscheck)), collapse = "\n"))
```

## Step 7 — Status over all features

This includes the CAMERA features outside the reference set (RT 60–1200 s).

```{r status-counts}
status_def <- data.frame(
  ref_status = c("Ref-unassigned (no-anchor)", "Ref-unassigned",
                 "Ref-confirmed", "Ref-conflicting", "Not evaluable",
                 "Ref-unmatched, co-grouped", "Ref-unmatched, unrelated"),
  definition = c(
    "Reference entry; the compound's anchor is not in a pcgroup",
    "Reference entry; anchor in a pcgroup, this feature not",
    "Same pcgroup as its compound's anchor",
    "Different pcgroup than its compound's anchor",
    "Technical check, should be 0: no anchor in the shared feature table",
    "No reference entry; pcgroup contains a compound anchor (possible over-grouping)",
    "No reference entry; pcgroup without an anchor, or no pcgroup"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

ref_status_summary <- eval_cam$status_counts %>%
  left_join(status_def, by = "ref_status")

ref_status_summary %>%
  kable(caption   = paste("Reference-relative status of all CAMERA features (", dataset, ")"),
        col.names = c("Status", "n", "% of all rows", "Definition")) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed")) %>%
  footnote(general = paste(
    "Rows = reference feature x compound rows plus CAMERA features outside the",
    "reference set. Ref-unmatched, unrelated reflects reference-set coverage,",
    "not a CAMERA grouping outcome."))
```

## Step 8 — Per-feature tables

`build_compound_instance_table()` and `build_full_feature_table()` add the
CAMERA columns (pcgroup, adduct label, anchor-pcgroup purity). Their
`ref_status` is replaced by the one from `evaluate_grouping()`, so every
table in this document uses the same status.

```{r per-feature-tables}
status_generic <- eval_cam$full_table %>%
  select(feature_name, Compound_name, ref_status_generic = ref_status) %>%
  distinct(feature_name, Compound_name, .keep_all = TRUE)

.use_generic_status <- function(tbl) {
  out <- tbl %>%
    left_join(status_generic,
              by = c("feature_name", "compound_instance" = "Compound_name"))
  out %>%
    select(-any_of("ref_status")) %>%
    rename(ref_status = ref_status_generic)
}

compound_instance_table <- build_compound_instance_table(
  eval_full                = eval_full,
  anchors                  = anchors,
  purity                   = purity,
  CAMERA_annotated_pool_FT = CAMERA_ft_sub,
  anno_accuracy            = anno_accuracy
) %>% .use_generic_status()

full_feature_table <- build_full_feature_table(
  eval_full                = eval_full,
  anchors                  = anchors,
  purity                   = purity,
  CAMERA_annotated_pool_FT = CAMERA_ft_sub,
  anno_accuracy            = anno_accuracy
) %>% .use_generic_status()
```

Examples: up to three rows per `ref_status`, so every status appears. The
full tables are exported in *Save outputs*.

```{r per-feature-preview}
status_examples <- full_feature_table %>%
  filter(!is.na(ref_status)) %>%
  group_by(ref_status) %>%
  slice_head(n = 3) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(ref_status)

kable(status_examples,
      caption = "Per-feature table: example rows for each ref_status") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), font_size = 10) %>%
  scroll_box(width = "100%", height = "450px")
```

# Save outputs

```{r save-outputs, eval = FALSE}
output_dir <- paste0("CAMERA_evaluation_output_", dataset, "_", format(Sys.Date(), "%Y%m%d"))
dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

.dash <- function(x) if_else(is.na(x), "-", as.character(x))
dash_cols <- c("compound_instance", "MS1Match_lib_group", "CAMERA_Anchor_pcgroup",
               "CAMERA_Anchor_pcgroup_purity", "CAMERA_Anchor_pcgroup_Refconfirmed_pct")
.out <- function(name) file.path(output_dir, paste0(name, "_", dataset, ".csv"))

write.csv(eval_full,                    .out("01_eval_full"),             row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(anchors,                      .out("02_anchors"),               row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(purity$anchor_pcgroups,       .out("03_anchor_pcgroup_purity"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(plot2_data,                   .out("03b_plot2_data"),           row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(compound_pcgroup_table,       .out("03c_compound_pcgroup"),     row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(anno_accuracy$summary,        .out("05a_anno_accuracy_summary"),      row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(anno_accuracy$per_compound,   .out("05b_anno_accuracy_per_compound"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(confusion_detail,             .out("05c_confusion_detail"),     row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(benchmark,                    .out("06_benchmark_table"),       row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(compound_instance_table %>% mutate(across(any_of(dash_cols), .dash)),
          .out("07_compound_instance_table"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(full_feature_table %>% mutate(across(any_of(dash_cols), .dash)),
          .out("07b_full_feature_table"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(ref_status_summary,           .out("09_ref_status_counts"),     row.names = FALSE)

# one row per anchor pcgroup: which compounds were merged into it
pcgroup_si_table <- anchors %>%
  left_join(purity$anchor_pcgroups, by = c("anchor_pcgroup" = "pcgroup")) %>%
  group_by(anchor_pcgroup, pcgroup_n_features, pcgroup_n_compounds, pcgroup_outside_ref) %>%
  summarise(compounds = paste(sort(unique(Compound_name)), collapse = ", "),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(outside_ref_pct = round(100 * pcgroup_outside_ref / pcgroup_n_features, 1)) %>%
  select(anchor_pcgroup, compounds, pcgroup_n_compounds, pcgroup_n_features, outside_ref_pct) %>%
  arrange(desc(pcgroup_n_compounds))
write.csv(pcgroup_si_table, .out("08_pcgroup_composition_summary"), row.names = FALSE)

saveRDS(list(eval_cam                = eval_cam,
             eval_full               = eval_full,
             anchors                 = anchors,
             purity                  = purity,
             plot2_data              = plot2_data,
             compound_pcgroup_table  = compound_pcgroup_table,
             compound_eval_wide      = compound_eval_wide,
             anno_accuracy           = anno_accuracy,
             confusion_detail        = confusion_detail,
             benchmark               = benchmark,
             compound_instance_table = compound_instance_table,
             full_feature_table      = full_feature_table),
        file.path(output_dir, paste0("CAMERA_evaluation_", dataset, "_all.rds")))
```

## N-Acetylneuraminate (over-grouping)

In this dataset, the anchor of N-Acetylneuraminate falls in the largest
over-grouped pcgroup. It shows how one grouping failure corrupts the adduct
labels of every compound in that pcgroup.

```{r case-neuraminate, results = "asis"}
show_case("N-Acetylneuraminate")
```
